title: Palate expander
what: This is an appliance with a screw that is fitted to the upper teeth. It is turned a little at a time, and the upper jaw becomes wider.
why: When the upper jaw is narrow, the teeth do not have enough room, or there is a crossbite.
duration: fitting usually takes 30 to 60 minutes, and it is usually worn for several months
tell_doctor: Problems with the nose and breathing
If your child grinds their teeth

prepare.title: Mood
prepare.text: Explain to your child that the appliance will be felt in the mouth, but they get used to it.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: The day before and on the day of fitting, prepare soft food.

bring: Soft food for the first days at home
steps: The doctor takes impressions or scans the teeth
The appliance is made from the impression
At the next visit it is fixed on the teeth
The doctor shows how to turn the screw with a key
Sets how often to turn it and when to come back
feel: Pressure in the teeth and palate after turning
In the first days it is hard to talk and swallow
A gap may appear between the front teeth - this is how it should be
after: Turn the screw exactly as your doctor said
Soft food for the first days, nothing hard or sticky
Brush your teeth and the appliance well
Come to check-ups on the set days
red_flags: The appliance came loose or broke
Severe pain or sores on the palate

faq.q: Why is there a gap between the teeth?
faq.a: It is a sign that the jaw is widening. Later the gap usually closes by itself or with the doctor's help.
Do not change the schedule yourself. If you missed one, tell your doctor.

reminders.text: Palate expander fitting tomorrow. Prepare soft food for the first days.
